name: quorx
description: An open-source AI agent with a quorum of models behind every call. Any model, through OpenRouter.

scripts.desktop:setup: cd desktop && npm install && node node_modules/electron/install.js
scripts.release:bump: npm --prefix desktop version patch --no-git-tag-version && node desktop/sync-version.js
scripts.test: node --test --test-force-exit --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=./scripts/results-reporter.mjs --test-reporter-destination=stdout scripts/test-loop.mjs scripts/test-browser.mjs scripts/test-agent.mjs scripts/test-security.mjs scripts/test-safety.mjs scripts/test-posix.mjs scripts/test-news.mjs scripts/test-newsremote.mjs scripts/test-backup.mjs scripts/test-storage.mjs scripts/test-scale.mjs scripts/test-integrity.mjs
